title: Velantrim Provenance Metadata
description: Provenance envelope attached to any operation that writes to or reads from the canonical graph. source_ref and trace_id are mandatory for any fact that claims to be auditable.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the metadata schema used (e.g. '1.0.0')

source_ref.description: Identifies the originating artifact, session or document. Missing source_ref is a validation failure for auditable facts.

trace_id.description: Links this record back to the answer-trace receipt that created it. Missing trace_id is a validation failure for auditable facts.

guardian_verified.description: Must default to false. Automatically imported or generated records must not claim guardian_verified=true unless the TruthGate explicitly set it.
